controls: Point-in-time S&P 500 membership for every cross-sectional test (no hindsight universe).
Purged walk-forward: every model is refitted each January on data whose target ended before that date.
The rules of every test were committed to git before it ran (docs/PREREGISTRATION*.md).
Deflated Sharpe ratios count every configuration tried in the project (43 by test 7).
Costs: 2 bp per unit of turnover for SPY, 7 bp for stocks, 0.5% a year to borrow shares, T-bills + 1% to borrow cash.
A signal at a close trades at the next close (daily) or holds for the next month (monthly); no same-bar fills.
Survivorship-biased results are labelled: pairs trading (today's S&P 100), crypto (today's coins), allocations (today's 30 names).

regime.label: Stress
regime.rule: Stress if VIX is above VIX3M (inverted) or GARCH volatility is in its top 10% of 10 years; Risk-on if SPY is above its 200-day average and volatility is below its 10-year median; else Neutral.

kelly.note: Kelly fraction f* = mean excess return / variance = Sharpe / volatility, from the backtest. It treats the backtest's Sharpe as the true future one. At the lower 95% bound of that Sharpe the fraction is much smaller, and on the fair point-in-time universe the strategy's edge is about zero, where Kelly is 0.
